# Every call, any command:
Error: Exit code 126        # stdout and stderr both empty

# --debug log shows only:
[Stall] tool_dispatch_end tool=Bash outcome=error durationMs=1302
Bash tool error (1302ms): code=tool_shell_error type=ShellError

# The shell-semantics proof:
$ zsh  -c 'exec 3<&-; exec 3<&- || exit 126; echo SURVIVED'   # no output, exits
$ bash -c 'exec 3<&-; exec 3<&- || exit 126; echo SURVIVED'   # SURVIVED
